minutes.headline: Parks Commission took no vote on 2021 field fees, agreed to a joint meeting on the skatepark, and set a Marshall Park walk.
minutes.summary: Little League representatives questioned the planned field usage fee increase and the lack of maintenance; the commission deferred any decision until the recreation director can attend. The commission agreed to a joint meeting with the Select Board on the skatepark while members restated opposition to the TC Passios site. Marshall Park planning, the track, open space updates and meeting dates were also discussed. The commission approved prior minutes and adjourned.

The chair will tell the Select Board the commission agrees to a joint meeting on the skatepark, suggesting early December or a visit to a commission meeting.

why_it_matters: Field usage fees for 2021 are still undecided, so families in youth leagues do not yet know whether the fee will rise or what maintenance it will pay for.
The commission has no budget of its own and fee money goes to a DPW-held account, so the fee question runs through town finances, not a commission vote alone.
A Marshall Park reimbursement grant needs a town share, and planning and engineering costs are not covered, so the project could later come to residents as a funding request.
